title.purpose: Section headings, dialogs, and drawer headers (15-16px Semibold).

body.purpose: Descriptions, table cells, and form labels (14px, 1.5 line-height).

label.purpose: Model names, masked API keys, endpoints, seeds, case_key, SHA-256 hashes, timestamps, latency, and tokens.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, drawers, and dropdown menus only.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Subtle 150ms state feedback transitions respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview: Restrained Zinc developer console focused on verifiable engineering evidence for M1 capabilities with WCAG 2.2 AA contrast across Light, Dark, and System themes.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutral luminance hierarchy with 1px borders
WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (>= 4.5:1) for all useful text in Light and Dark
Evidence-based status semantics: neutral text badges for types, status colors only for real verified outcomes
Strict UI sans vs technical monospace split
Full keyboard navigation and accessible focus management

rules.name: Evidence-Only Status Colors
rules.body: Never draw green health dots or inferred healthy states without a real test response.

rules.name: Contrast Floor 4.5:1
rules.body: Dark muted text must be at least #A1A1AA and light muted text at least #5E5E66 on surface/subtle fills.

rules.name: Strict M1 Boundary
rules.body: Never expose M2-M5 metrics, fake dashboards, or non-functional navigation in M1.
